name: Centana Intrastate Pipeline (Phase I and II)
monitor_reason: endpoints and sourcing: only EIA states it; no start/end points beyond Gulf of Mexico/Louisiana, no second source; may be a 1996 Gulf gathering line rather than transmission
researcher_notes: No existing GEM row under this name (checked roster). EIA Aug 2026 release, sheet 'Historical Projects (1996-2024)', Excel row 10: 'Centana Phase I, Phase II', sponsor Centana Energy Corp., New Pipeline, Completed, in service Nov 1996, 81 mi, 30 in, 300 MMcf/d, states GM and LA, listed as Interstate under FERC. Web searches found Centana Intrastate Pipeline LLC (later owned via Duke Energy Field Services then Crosstex per a 2003 sale) and Centana Oil Gathering, but no independent document giving the route, length or diameter. Endpoints are unknown, so the add threshold (country plus endpoints) is not met on one source. Length 81 mi passes the 25 km rule if confirmed. Revisit with FERC filings or Gulf of Mexico BOEM pipeline records. Route: none found.
